title: Kehar Singh v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Kehar Singh v. Union of India, (1989) 1 SCC 204
content.holding: President can re-examine evidence on merits in a mercy petition; convict has no right to oral hearing; judicial review is limited to checking arbitrary exercise of power.
content.relevance: Nature of presidential mercy in capital punishment cases.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Crl.) No. 526 of 1988; 1988 INSC 379; (1989) 1 SCC 204; 1988 Supp (3) SCR 1102.
